title: Which controller seats the module: the guarded advance or the learned policy
question: On the same rack, the same three held-out seeds and the same capture and extraction checkpoints, does the learned insert policy seat better than the scripted guarded advance?
decision: the scripted guarded advance keeps the chain's seating phase
decision_rule: the policy takes the seating phase only if it wins pooled AND on every shared seed; a controller better on average and worse on one seed has a failure mode nobody has looked at, and the guarded advance is the one with a published interval
